# GSAP 3.15.0

Locally vendored `dist/gsap.min.js` and `dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js` from the
official npm package `gsap@3.15.0`, retrieved through jsDelivr.
The original license notices are preserved in both files.

License: https://gsap.com/standard-license/
Source/package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/gsap/v/3.15.0

No CDN connection is required at runtime.
